value: No private or authenticated production data
Clean up generated preview fixtures after tests
All required type-check, unit test, inspect, build, E2E, package smoke, and benchmark gates must pass
Critical and high defects cannot be waived
Only framework maintainers may explicitly accept documented low or medium residual risk
Logical focus order and visible focus
Live announcements for status and feedback
Reject path traversal and linked escape paths
Reject changed source or screenshot hashes after capture
Never retain or expose sensitive data
Enforce screenshot count and size limits
CocoUX approval must never promote application source
Static check and artifact generation under 2 seconds
At most 50 PNG files, 5 MiB each, and 100 MiB per revision
CLI and Agent Bridge use the same UX engine
Existing CocoSpec and CocoRef lifecycles remain unchanged
Port collision and missing Chromium recovery

cases.title: Given the same canonical inputs, generated outputs are deterministic, versioned, and machine-readable.
cases.evidence: npm test: deterministic CocoUX engine and CLI artifact tests passed; npm run check passed.

cases.title: Every journey has no dead end and every transition declares a trigger and outcome.
cases.evidence: npm test passed focused journey validation for declared triggers, outcomes, and dead-end detection.

cases.title: Initial, loading, empty, success, validation, disabled, error, offline, and permission states are reviewed.
cases.evidence: npm test passed required-state coverage checks for all nine approved state categories.

cases.title: Every interaction declares trigger, target, feedback, keyboard behavior, and recovery.
cases.evidence: npm test passed interaction contract checks for trigger, target, feedback, keyboard behavior, and recovery.

cases.title: Visual recommendations reuse existing components and design tokens before proposing additions.
cases.evidence: npm test passed project inventory, reuse-decision, token, and explicit missing-component consent checks.

cases.title: CocoUX renders a real development-only website preview and captures PNG evidence for approved viewports, themes, and states.
cases.evidence: Real Playwright integration captured five valid PNG previews from a local development-only CocoUX route; full E2E passed.

cases.title: Every screenshot records its viewport, theme, state, revision, source hash, and linked UX contract.
cases.evidence: npm test passed screenshot manifest assertions for viewport, theme, state, revision, source hash, and UX contract linkage.

cases.title: CocoUX approval permits only handoff of the approved visual direction to CocoRef and never promotes application source.
cases.evidence: npm test passed approval and immutable evidence checks; approved CocoUX does not promote application source.

cases.title: CocoRef receives the approved screenshots and linked UX contract, then retains inventory audit, missing-component consent, exact-preview approval, and source promotion ownership.
cases.evidence: npm test passed CocoUX-to-CocoRef handoff with copied visual references and UX hash linkage while CocoRef ownership remains intact.

cases.title: Temporary CocoUX preview files are removed after successful handoff or cancellation.
cases.evidence: npm test passed managed preview cleanup for successful handoff and cancellation.

cases.title: When an external visual reference exists, CocoRef remains the source of fidelity decisions.
cases.evidence: npm test passed CocoRef linkage behavior; fidelity decisions remain represented by the CocoRef lifecycle.

cases.title: CocoQA can derive traceable cases from approved CocoUX and completed CocoRef.
cases.evidence: npm test passed CocoQA derivation from approved CocoUX and completed CocoRef traceability inputs.

cases.title: CLI and Agent Bridge use the same CocoUX engine and contract.
cases.evidence: npm test and npm run inspect passed shared CLI and read-only Agent Bridge CocoUX contract coverage.

cases.title: Useful server-rendered output exists without browser JavaScript.
cases.evidence: Package smoke passed SSR and production builds for every official template; CocoUX preview scaffolds server-rendered routes.

cases.title: Keyboard, focus, labels, errors, and semantic structure satisfy the approved accessibility target.
cases.evidence: Full Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit E2E passed keyboard flows, focus behavior, semantic dialogs, 200 percent text zoom, and forced colors.

cases.title: Every changed internal link, CTA, route, anchor, and API target returns successful content or an intentional redirect; external targets have sanitized provider evidence.
cases.evidence: Full E2E, local documentation inspection, and package smoke passed route, CTA, API, redirect, and 404 reachability checks.

cases.title: Every changed link and control has an accessible name, keyboard behavior, visible focus, and an action matching its label.
cases.evidence: Full cross-browser E2E passed accessible keyboard-operated catalogs, dialogs, forms, islands, and controls.

cases.title: The feature remains usable across the approved viewport and device range without horizontal overflow.
cases.evidence: Responsive E2E passed 320x568, 390x844, 768x1024, 1366x768, and 3840x2160 without horizontal overflow.
